findings.evidence: `CongruenceSubgroup.neg_one_mem_Gamma1_iff` at `TauCeti/NumberTheory/ModularForms/CongruenceSubgroups.lean:152` states `-I ∈ Γ₁(N) ↔ N ∣ 2`; meanwhile `-I` acts trivially on ℍ, so for e.g. N=3 the two SL₂ cosets give identical domain tiles. The roadmap at lines 443–448 explicitly requires the effective PSL₂ quotient.
findings.fix: Construct the quotient through the effective PSL₂ action (equivalently adjoin `-I` to `Gamma1 N` or deduplicate the ± cosets) and prove the resulting sum represents the subgroup fundamental domain.
findings.issue: Indexing by `SL(2, ℤ) ⧸ Gamma1 N` counts the distinct cosets of `q` and `-q`, although they induce the same translate of `fd`; for N ∤ 2 this is twice the effective-PSL Petersson integral claimed by the file and roadmap.

summary: The coset sum uses the ineffective SL₂ quotient and double-counts the intended Γ₁(N) fundamental domain whenever N ∤ 2.
